theorem lg_target {R : Type u_2} {a b : R} [CommRing R] {r : R} : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b) ↔ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [nonZeroDivisors_def, nonZeroDivisors_def]
    rintro ⟨s, hs⟩ (h1 : s * _ = 0)
    rcases hs with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h2 : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r * x = 0 := by rw [mul_assoc]; exact h1
    rw [algebraMap_def] at h2
    simp only [algebraMap_def, mul_assoc] at h2
    rw [h2]
    exact hx

    rw [nonZeroDivisors_def, nonZeroDivisors_def]
